conflicts.impact: Blocks validation of both specifications and affects 3+ other specs
conflicts.resolution: Deploy dashboard authentication fix or debug existing deployment

conflicts.spec1: User Activity Tracking - CLI to Dashboard Data Flow
conflicts.description: Specification says 'Support both JWT and API key authentication flows' but implementation uses different auth methods for different endpoints (POST accepts API key, GET requires JWT). Validation harness assumes single auth method.
conflicts.rootCause: Ambiguous specification - doesn't clarify which endpoints support which auth methods
conflicts.impact: Validation harness cannot complete full end-to-end testing
conflicts.resolution: Either: (1) Clarify spec to document auth method per endpoint, or (2) Add API key support to GET endpoints, or (3) Update harness for dual auth
